title: Summoned by the house
text: The elders of the {player.familyName} line summon you to swear yourself to the family's name and duties.

choices.label: Swear to the line
choices.text: Duty, money and expectations, for life.

effects.text: You kneel, swear, and stand up as an heir of the {player.familyName} line.

choices.label: Renounce the name
choices.text: Walk out of the hall, and leave the money behind.

effects.text: You walk out of the hall. The family's money stays with the family.
